text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif

text.tspan: The total disease burden is measured as the number of Disability-Adjusted Life Years (DALYs) per year.
DALYs measure the total burden of disease – both from years of life lost due to premature death and years lived
with a disability. One DALY equals one lost year of healthy life.
